decisions.question: S62 added a G13 clause and case (navResolver builds its stage functions once per call, so the value one call returns re-activates to its handle under bus-api@v2 G23), which nidana.navigation.3 and .6 replay, and which nidana.navigation D5 and .3's Scope must state. The intake's insert rule adds a phase-plan step and its reconcile for a node routed to the H23 sweep when a contract handoff changes the behavior a phase of it implements or replays. Does the rule apply?

options.label: Apply it: hsdd-phase-plan on nidana.navigation after its spec touch, then a reconcile
options.consequence: The phases that build and replay the resolver are restated by the skill that owns them; H23 skips nidana.navigation. Two more steps.

options.label: Leave it to the H23 sweep
options.consequence: One fewer step, but a reconcile sweep would rewrite a plan-written decision (D5) and a phase scope for a behavior change, which the record reserves for hsdd-phase-plan.

decisions.chosen: Apply it: hsdd-phase-plan on nidana.navigation after its spec touch, then a reconcile
decisions.why: The rule's condition holds as written: .3 implements the resolver whose stage functions must now be built outside the declaration body, and .3 and .6 replay the new case. The record wrote the rule for exactly this case.
